NDI.Title: NelTempo
NDI.Lifecycle.ManualReviewRequired: Manual Review Required — resolve lifecycle recovery before advancing.
NDI.Lifecycle.TransitionBusy: A phase transition is already in progress.
NDI.Lifecycle.UnfinishedTurns: {count} combatant(s) have not ended their turn.
NDI.Lifecycle.CannotAdvanceUseDialog: Cannot advance: {count} turn(s) incomplete. Use Return, Process Remaining, or Advance Without Processing.
NDI.Lifecycle.DialogFallbackForce: OK = Advance Without Processing (no end-of-turn effects). Cancel = Return to Phase.
NDI.Lifecycle.NotOpen: The phase is not open for turn actions.
NDI.Lifecycle.CannotEndTurn: That combatant cannot end their turn right now.
NDI.Lifecycle.StartFailed: Phase start processing failed. Use recovery controls.
NDI.Lifecycle.EndFailed: Phase end processing failed. Use recovery controls.
NDI.Lifecycle.NoFailedStart: There is no failed start boundary to recover.
NDI.Lifecycle.NoFailedEnd: There is no failed end boundary to recover.
NDI.Lifecycle.PhaseCompletePrompt: The {phase} phase is complete. Advance to the next phase?
NDI.Lifecycle.ForceAdvanceConfirm: Advance without processing {count} unfinished combatant(s)? End-of-turn effects will NOT run for skipped combatants, and will not run later automatically.
NDI.Lifecycle.EndRemainingConfirm: Process native end-of-turn for every incomplete combatant in this phase (persistent damage, conditions, etc.)?
NDI.Lifecycle.StartReviewNeeded: One or more start-of-turn effects require review. Other combatants may continue.
NDI.Lifecycle.ProcessRemainingFailed: Could not finish processing remaining turns. Resolve Review before advancing.
NDI.Lifecycle.ProcessRemainingIncomplete: Some turns are still incomplete after processing.
NDI.Lifecycle.AdvanceWithoutProcessingDi: Advance Without Processing is disabled in settings.
NDI.Lifecycle.ReminderEnd: End of turn: resolve end-of-turn effects for {name}.
NDI.Lifecycle.Status.Ready: Start effects complete — ready to act
NDI.Lifecycle.MigrationNotice: NelTempo turn timing was added during an active round. Existing combatants were not processed retroactively.
NDI.Undo.PhaseEndWarning: This undo restores NelTempo phase state only. Native PF2e end-of-turn results (persistent damage, conditions, effects, chat, and third-party hooks) are not automatically reversed.
NDI.Setting.AutoAdvancePhase.Name: Advance Completed Phases Automatically
NDI.Setting.AutoAdvancePhase.Hint: When every combatant in the phase has ended their turn (including native end-of-turn): Off waits for the GM, Prompt asks the authoritative GM once, Automatic advances to the next phase without re-running completed ends.
NDI.Setting.TurnLifecycleAutomation.Name: Turn Lifecycle Automation
NDI.Setting.TurnLifecycleAutomation.Hint: Off tracks phase/turn completion only. Reminders Only announces boundaries without invoking PF2e. Native PF2e Processing invokes supported start/end turn operations.
NDI.Setting.PhaseLifecycleSummary.Name: Phase Lifecycle Summary
NDI.Setting.PhaseLifecycleSummary.Hint: Optional informational summary after phase start processing. Not used as transaction proof.
NDI.Setting.GuardIncompletePhase.Name: Guard Incomplete Phase
NDI.Setting.GuardIncompletePhase.Hint: When On, advancing with unfinished turns opens the GM dialog (Return / Process Remaining / Advance Without Processing). When Off, Advance Phase skips pending end boundaries immediately without native end-of-turn processing and never traps the GM.
NDI.Setting.AllowAdvanceWithoutProcessin: Show the emergency Advance Without Processing option. It is never the default choice.
NDI.Setting.ManageRaisedShield.Name: Manage Raise a Shield / Parry
NDI.Setting.ManageRaisedShield.Hint: Keep Raise a Shield and Parry active until that creature's next start-of-turn (phase activation), then remove them.
NDI.Setting.EnforceConditionTiming.Name: Enforce Condition Timing
NDI.Setting.EnforceConditionTiming.Hint: When On, Grabbed and Restrained block voluntary Delay, and Confused combatants must resolve before others in the same phase. When Off, lifecycle and End Turn remain fully functional without timing restrictions.
NDI.Notify.SelectTokens: Select the tokens that belong in the encounter, then start NelTempo again.
NDI.Notify.AlreadyActive: NelTempo is already active for this encounter.
NDI.Notify.PromptOnlyInitiative: Initiative can only be prompted during the Initiative phase.
NDI.Notify.ChecksComplete: All NelTempo checks are complete. The GM can begin Vanguard.
NDI.Error.UserInactive: The requesting user is not active.
NDI.Error.PromptInactive: That initiative prompt is no longer active.
NDI.Error.NotOwner: You do not own that combatant.
NDI.Error.DcNumber: Enemy Initiative DC must be a number.
NDI.Error.NotEligible: That combatant is not eligible in the current phase.
NDI.Error.AlreadyActed: That combatant has already acted this phase.
NDI.Error.OtherActive: Another combatant is currently taking a turn.
NDI.Error.GmOnlyEnemies: Only the GM can activate enemies.
NDI.Error.DelayOnlyVanguard: Only Vanguard combatants can delay to Rearguard.
NDI.Error.GmOnly: Only the GM can perform that action.
NDI.Timing.DelayBlocked: Delay is blocked by a condition.
NDI.Timing.AllowDelayOnceGranted: Allow Delay Once granted for this phase.
NDI.Timing.ResumeGranted: Resume Current Actor Once granted for this phase.
NDI.Timing.OverrideNeedsConfirm: Confirm the timing override before continuing.
NDI.Timing.ConfusedReopenRejected: Players cannot reopen a resolved Confused turn.
NDI.Timing.UseReopenConfusedControl: Use Reopen Confused Turn to reopen this combatant.
NDI.Timing.AdapterWarning: NelTempo could not read a PF2e condition safely; timing failed open for that combatant.
NDI.Timing.AllowDelayConfirm: Allow this combatant to Delay once despite Grabbed, Restrained, or Confused? The condition is not removed.
NDI.Timing.ResolvePriorityConfirm: Mark this Confused combatant as timing-resolved without End Turn processing? The Confused condition is not removed.
NDI.Timing.SkipPriorityConfirm: Skip the Confused priority requirement for this combatant this phase? Their turn remains open unless separately ended.
NDI.Timing.ReopenConfusedConfirm: Reopen this Confused turn? Actor state and actions are not reversed. Confused priority may be reactivated.
NDI.Placement.CorrectionRejected: That placement correction is not allowed right now.
NDI.Placement.TurnCompleted: This combatant has already completed its turn this round.
NDI.Placement.LifecycleBusy: A lifecycle boundary is currently processing.
NDI.Placement.PendingUnsafe: Return to Pending is no longer safe this round.
NDI.Placement.QueueInstead: Queue this correction for the next round instead.
NDI.Placement.StateChanged: Initiative state changed. Reopen the editor.
NDI.Placement.UndoNativeWarning: Native turn-start effects are not automatically reversed. PF2e actor changes, reactions, effect processing, and third-party hooks are not undone.
NDI.Placement.QueueExists: A next-round correction is already queued. Confirm to replace it.
NDI.Placement.NoQueue: There is no queued next-round correction.
NDI.Placement.ReplaceQueuedConfirm: Replace the existing next-round placement correction?
NDI.Portrait.OffScene: This combatant’s token is not on the active scene.
NDI.Portrait.NoPermission: You do not have permission to control this combatant.
NDI.Portrait.TokenMissing: Combatant token could not be found.
NDI.Setting.PanCameraOnPortrait.Name: Pan Camera When Activating Portrait
NDI.Setting.PanCameraOnPortrait.Hint: When enabled, clicking a NelTempo portrait centers your camera on that combatant’s token.
NDI.Setting.InterfaceScale.Name: NelTempo Interface Scale (legacy)
NDI.Setting.InterfaceScale.Hint: Legacy whole-dock zoom. Replaced by Portrait Scale and Phase Bar Scale in 0.3.4; retained for migration only.
NDI.Setting.PortraitScale.Name: Portrait Scale
NDI.Setting.PortraitScale.Hint: Visually scales combatant portrait art for this browser. Control buttons keep a usable click size.
NDI.Setting.PhaseBarScale.Name: Phase Bar Scale
NDI.Setting.PhaseBarScale.Hint: Scales only the NelTempo phase/status bar for this browser.
NDI.Setting.PhaseBarLayout.Name: Phase Bar Layout
NDI.Setting.PhaseBarLayout.Hint: Auto chooses Compact when space or bar scale is constrained. Compact shows a primary action plus an overflow menu.
NDI.Portrait.ActivateAndEditTip: Left-click: select combatant. Right-click: edit initiative/phase.
NDI.Keybinding.EndCurrentTurn.Name: NelTempo: End Current Turn
NDI.Keybinding.EndCurrentTurn.Hint: Ends the turn for your only eligible owned combatant. Unbound by default.
NDI.Keybinding.EndCurrentTurn.NotEligibl: No single eligible owned combatant to End Turn.
NDI.Chat.StartedBody: Set the Enemy Initiative DC, then prompt the players to roll.
NDI.Countdown.Label: Countdown Label
NDI.Countdown.StartHint: Optional public encounter countdown. Leave blank to skip.
NDI.Countdown.Invalid: Enter a label and rounds between 1 and 99.
